everfall.feature.fireflies.desc: Fireflies drift near the bottom of the screen in spring and summer, from 22:00 to 04:00.
everfall.feature.custom.desc: Add this effect when its time and season come around.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.everfall: Adds seasonal particles to menus with physics and cursor interaction.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.everfall: Adds seasonal particles to menus with physics and cursor interaction.
everfall.config.title: Everfall Settings
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.show: Show particles in your inventory, pause menu, and other in-game menus.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.prof: The seasonal theme. Turn off automatic selection to choose it yourself.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.maxP: Maximum number of particles on screen.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.wind: Wind strength and direction: negative values blow left, positive values blow right.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.grav: Higher values pull particles downward more strongly.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.pixe: Display pixels give smoother movement. GUI pixels follow the interface grid.
yacl3.config.everfall:client_config.auto: Change the theme to match the time of year in your region.
